name: Goatstealer

source.note: The Crooked Moon (Legends of Avantris), appendix A. Numbers are the book's; the words are ours. Familiar block (CR 1). Bond ritual: 10 minutes with materials worth 100+ gp (incense and spoiled meat); the Familiar Bond rules (bonded sympathy, channel magic, telepathic connection, 1-hour revival) are on page 580 and are listed once in the notes file.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.summary: Advantage on attack rolls against a target that has a non-Incapacitated ally of this creature within 5 ft.

traits.name: Stench
traits.summary: Creatures starting a turn within 5 ft: DC 12 Con save or Poisoned until their next turn; a success gives an hour's immunity.
traits.text: Constitution save, DC 12, for any creature that starts its turn within 5 feet. Failure: Poisoned until the start of its next turn. Success: immune to all goatstealers' Stench for 1 hour.

actions.name: Bite
actions.summary: +4, 1d6+2 Piercing plus 1d6 Poison; a Medium or smaller target is Grappled (escape DC 12) and takes 1d6 Poison at the start of each of the goatstealer's turns.
actions.text: Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing plus 3 (1d6) Poison damage. A Medium or smaller target is Grappled (escape DC 12); until the grapple ends, at the start of each of the goatstealer's turns the target takes 3 (1d6) Poison damage.

summary: A hairless, reeking livestock-hunter that bites, poisons and hangs on, strongest in a pack.
